$comment: Declared export surface of every em++ module Hyphon links — the one list of each C API.
The top-level buckets are public/hyphon_native.wasm (both threading profiles); the
`rubberband` and `mixBus` sections are public/rubberband.wasm and public/mix_bus.wasm.
Each build script exports exactly its section (tools/hyphon_native_exports.mjs --module),
gen:native-types types it (src/shared/rt/{hyphonNative,rubberband,mixBus}Exports.ts), and
check:native-types fails on a TS caller of a name no section declares.
emscripten/build.sh exports exactly the top-level buckets, and
tools/check_wasm_export_map.mjs fails the build on any drift from it.
`required` exports are called by shipped worklet / engine code — a build that
drops one of them is broken.
`optional` exports are always built but not called by shipped code (the immediate API stays for tooling and host tests).
`runtime` names are added by Emscripten itself (pthread internals); never requested.
Each HYPHON_EXPORT_VOICE(prefix, ...) engine contributes prefix_create/_destroy/_init/
_push_event/_render/_cancel_notes/_flush/_event_inbox (src/__tests__/wasmExportManifest.voices.test.ts).
`debug` exports are linked into the debug build profile only (emscripten/core/stack_probe.cpp, the STACK_SIZE probe); a release map never has them.
Anything present in the export map but listed in no bucket is reported as
unexpected export bloat.
public/rubberband.wasm (emscripten/build_rubberband.sh). There is no glue: the worklets
instantiate the wasm by hand (src/audio-worklets/rubberband/instantiate.ts) and expose
each export as these names with a leading underscore (module._rb_create). rb_* is the
stretcher (rubberband_wrapper.cpp, wrapped by src/audio-worklets/rubberband/stretcher.ts),
rb_fx_* the vocal FX chain (rubberband_fx.cpp, rubberband/nativeVocalFx.ts).
tools/check_rubberband_module.mjs reads the linked wasm (names are unminified:
-lexports.js) and fails on a missing `required` name, on any export in neither
`required` nor `runtime`, and on any import not in `imports` — the exact set
instantiate.ts implements (src/__tests__/rubberbandInstantiate.test.ts).
public/mix_bus.wasm (emscripten/build_mix_bus.sh), STANDALONE_WASM: the wasm export
names are `required`, unprefixed, plus `memory` / `_initialize` and the `runtime`
names Emscripten adds itself (never requested). Bound by
src/audio/offline/mixBus/mixBusKernel.ts; tools/check_mix_bus_module.mjs fails on a
missing name or on any export in no bucket.
public/rust_osc.wasm (rust-audio/, scripts/build-rust-osc.mjs), a no_std cdylib with no
imports: the wasm export names are `required`, plus `memory`. Bound by
src/audio-worklets/rust-osc-processor.ts; tools/check_rust_osc_module.mjs fails on a
missing name or on any export not listed here. rosc_render_scalar is the scalar
reference path the SIMD rosc_render is parity-tested against. `requiredFilter` is the
Rust filter (#1672) in the same module: a resonant LP/BP/HP RBJ biquad run as a streaming
stage by src/audio-worklets/rust-filter-processor.ts, so any oscillator engine can use it.
public/cpp_osc.wasm (emscripten/build_cpp_osc.sh), STANDALONE_WASM with no imports: the wasm
export names are `required`, unprefixed, plus `memory` / `_initialize` and the `runtime` names
Emscripten adds itself (never requested). Bound by src/audio-worklets/cpp-osc-processor.ts and
src/audio/offline/OfflineCppOscEngine.ts; tools/check_cpp_osc_module.mjs fails on a missing
name or on any export in no bucket. The `cflt_*` names are the C++ filter (#1673) in the same
module: a resonant LP/BP/HP state variable filter run as a streaming stage by
src/audio-worklets/cpp-filter-processor.ts, so any oscillator engine can use it.
public/dwgs_osc.wasm (dwgs-audio/, scripts/build-dwgs-osc.mjs), a no_std cdylib with no
imports: the wasm export names are `required`, plus `memory`. Bound by
src/audio-worklets/dwgs-osc-processor.ts and src/audio/offline/OfflineDwgsOscEngine.ts;
tools/check_dwgs_osc_module.mjs fails on a missing name or on any export not listed here.
`requiredFilter` is the DWGS filter (#1674) in the same module: a resonant LP/BP/HP 4-pole
ladder with saturated feedback, run as a streaming stage by
src/audio-worklets/dwgs-filter-processor.ts, so any oscillator engine can use it.
